author: Praxis IV
title: Idea 2: Local distance z-scoring (k′=k+20) before vanilla kNN(k=50), cosine
abstract: Re-rank per-row candidate neighbor distances by z-scoring over a larger candidate pool (k′=k+20), then select top-k; keep binary connectivities and true distances. Hypothesis: mitigates per-cell scale heterogeneity on the simple PCA+kNN baseline.
